name: Do I need a permit to widen a doorway in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to widen a doorway in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, widening a doorway, especially if it involves altering a load-bearing wall or significantly changing the structure of your home, typically requires a building permit in Daly City and other Bay Area cities. Permits ensure the work meets local building codes and safety standards. Our team can help determine if a permit is necessary for your specific project and assist with the application process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, widening a doorway, especially structural changes, usually requires a building permit in Daly City to ensure compliance with local codes.
